rules.statement: Wrap code comments at about 120 columns in every kind of source file, including CSS and markup comments in web components, not only in Markdown and `//`/`///` comments.
rules.why: A single long comment line is hard to read and makes the next edit reflow it; the surrounding comments already wrap at about 120 columns.
rules.check: Look for added or changed comments in any file (for example CSS `/* */` blocks in .astro, .css or .html files) that run well past 120 columns on one line when the comments around them wrap; ask for them to be rewrapped as multi-line block comments.
